name: Oscar Mayer Deli Fresh Oven Roasted Turkey Breast Slices
whyItWorks: Thinly shaved, skinless, lean turkey breast slices. It requires virtually zero chewing effort, delivers 10g protein per 2-oz serving with under 1g fat, and has no roughage or spicy pepper coatings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Roll slices up for a quick protein snack, or layer between white bread with mild cheddar.
watchOuts: Contains added sodium for preservation; drink water alongside deli meats.
